name: 02905 · Providence, RI
findings: ZIP 02905 (Providence) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02905 (Providence) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02905 (Providence) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
